title: copilot-survey survey definition
description: One survey, as a file in apps/copilot-survey/surveys/ and as an item of GET /api/v1/surveys/active. schema_version goes up on every change to the format. New fields are optional, so a client built against an older version keeps working: it ignores fields it does not know, and skips a survey with a question type it does not know. copilot-survey also checks what a schema cannot express (unique question ids, skip_if pointing at an earlier question, starts <= ends, at most one text question); see surveys/README.md.

series.description: Groups the waves of one survey over time; each wave has its own id.

active.description: Served and takes answers only when true and today is within starts-ends.

nudge.description: When nav-pilot brings the survey up unasked. Left out means calm.

id.description: Stable across waves, like a question id. The same id and version as a scale question in another wave compare.

reverse.description: Agreeing is the negative end. For analysis; clients ignore it.

id.description: Stable across waves, never reused for another question.

version.description: Goes up on any change that could change how people answer. Same id and version in two waves compare.

construct.description: What the question measures. For analysis; clients ignore it.

reverse.description: scale: agreeing is the negative end. For analysis; clients ignore it.

min.description: scale, matrix: lowest step. Left out means 0.

max.description: scale, matrix: highest step, at most 10 steps above min.

labels.description: scale, matrix: one label per step, min to max.

options.description: choice, multi. Stored as the option text.

max_choices.description: multi: at most this many; 0 or left out means any.

other.description: choice, multi: the label of one more option that takes a short free text. Choosing it stores the label as the answer, like an option; the text is sent and stored under <id>.other. Needs max_length (at most 200). Not one of options.

max_length.description: text, and the free text of other: in characters.

items.description: matrix: statements that share its scale. Each is answered, versioned and stored as a scale question of its own, under its id; the matrix's own id and version are not stored. Item ids share the question ids' namespace.

skip_if.description: Skip this optional question when an earlier choice answer is, or multi answer includes, answer.
